name: apphandoff
description: AppHandoff for Claude Code: brings the AppHandoff MCP connection (sign in once with /mcp) and wakes a chat when someone posts on a ticket it claimed or created (it claims the ticket for the chat first, a write on your board, and releases it on a /clear or, after a quit, from the next chat you start on that computer, else the lock lapses in 20 minutes; a person's message makes the chat ask you what to do through a board question) or decides a milestone approval or answers a question it asked, or when a person accepts or drops a milestone it worked on, and, only if you turn it on with /inbox standby, lets one chat answer for the board by claiming messages nobody answered. /pg opens a pane with a program's progress and its milestones, read (read-only) from the board the chat already uses.
